examples.why: The same concept is named 분할 in the setup/definition sections and 파티션 in the post-processing sections, so the reader must re-link the decoded output to the x_i := sgn(⟨Π_i⟩) definition. Recognizable, so MINOR, but it breaks the thread of the tutorial.

examples.source: |E| is the number of edges … We repeat this process for all possible pairs of nodes connected by an edge.
examples.translation: $|E|$는 간선의 수이고 … 이 과정을 에지로 연결된 모든 가능한 노드 쌍에 대해 반복합니다.
examples.suggested: …이 과정을 간선으로 연결된 모든 가능한 노드 쌍에 대해 반복합니다.
examples.why: "Edge" is 간선 in the graph-theory sections but transliterated 에지 in the swap-search paragraph. 간선 is the standard Korean graph-theory term and is already established in this file; the late switch is an unnecessary inconsistency.

examples.source: ### Step 3: Execute using Qiskit primitives / ### Step 4: Post-process and return result in desired classical format
examples.translation: ### Step 3: Qiskit 프리미티브를 사용하여 실행 / ### Step 4: 결과를 후처리하여 원하는 고전적 형식으로 반환
examples.suggested: ### 3단계: Qiskit 프리미티브를 사용하여 실행 / ### 4단계: 결과를 후처리하여 원하는 고전적 형식으로 반환
examples.why: Steps 1 and 2 are rendered "1단계:"/"2단계:" but steps 3 and 4 keep the bare English "Step", so the four-step spine of the tutorial reads as two different documents in the sidebar and on the page.

examples.source: …representing the optimization problem as a correlation matrix — specifically, two-body Pauli-matrix correlations across n=3 qubits (Q1, Q2, Q3). Node colors indicate the Pauli string used for each encoded node.
examples.translation: …2체(two-body) Pauli 행렬 상관관계로서 최적화 문제를 상관관계 행렬로 나타냅니다 — 노드의 색상은 각 인코딩된 노드에 사용된 Pauli 문자열을 나타냅니다.
examples.suggested: …최적화 문제를 상관관계 행렬, 구체적으로는 $n=3$ qubit $(Q_1, Q_2, Q_3)$에 걸친 2체 Pauli 행렬 상관관계로 나타냅니다. 노드의 색상은 각 인코딩된 노드에 사용된 Pauli 문자열을 나타냅니다.
examples.why: The English em-dash introduces an appositive ("specifically, …"); the Korean moves that clause forward and then reuses the dash to glue on a wholly separate sentence about node colors. Meaning survives, but it reads as a calqued run-on rather than Korean a technical writer would produce.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I checked the quantitative claims in the closing analysis (γ² ≈ 1.6×10² for full PEC, "추가로 약 3.4배" reduction to γ² ≈ 48, "대략 3분의 1의 샘플링 비용", the 10% band applying only to PEC+SLC, and the "과소평가하는 일은 절대 없습니다" timeout caveat) and every conditional/negation in the speed-limit and backward-bound bullets is correctly oriented; nothing would mislead a learner. What a native editor would fix is consistency: the file splits down the middle between an early and a late translation convention. "error" is 오차 in the first half (오차 완화, 확률적 오차 상쇄) but 오류 from roughly "수동 검사를 위한 SLC 시각화" onward (오류 완화, 확률적 오류 증폭 in Next steps); "twirling" is 트와이링 early and 트월링 later; "post-selection" is 사후 선택 early and 후선택 later; "two-qubit" is 2-큐비트 early and 이중 큐비트 later; and "bound"/"shade" are left as bare English inside otherwise-Korean prose (SLC bound 계산, 노이즈 bound, 더 타이트한 bound, 계산된 shade) although the same concepts are rendered 경계/자명한 경계/음영 elsewhere in the file. Two smaller word-choice slips: "fractional gates" → "부분 게이트" (partial gates) and "the bounded errors from our quantum circuit" → "경계 오류", which reads like "boundary errors" rather than "경계가 지어진(한계가 정해진) 오류".

examples.source: error mitigation … probabilistic error amplification
examples.translation: 오차 완화 (배경, 학습 목표) vs 오류 완화 / 확률적 오류 증폭 (3단계·4단계·다음 단계)
examples.suggested: Pick one — the page title already commits to 오차 상쇄, so use 오차 완화 / 확률적 오차 증폭 throughout
examples.why: The same core word 'error' is rendered two ways within one tutorial, split roughly at the midpoint; the concept stays identifiable, so MINOR, but a reader hitting 오류 완화 after 20 screens of 오차 완화 will wonder if a different thing is meant.

examples.source: The SLC bound computations … the computed shades are upper bounds … tightens the bounds
examples.translation: SLC bound 계산 … 노이즈 bound를 추정 … 계산된 shade는 상한(upper bound)이므로 … bound가 더 느슨해질(trivial) 뿐
examples.suggested: SLC 경계 계산 … 노이즈 경계 … 계산된 음영은 모든 단계에서 상한이므로 … 해당 레이어의 경계가 자명한 값으로 느슨해질 뿐
examples.why: 'bound' and 'shade' are translated (경계 / 음영) in the surrounding sections but left as bare lowercase English inside these three admonitions, so the same object is named two different ways on the same page.

examples.source: instantiate it with fractional gates turned on. These fractional gates allow for greater sensitivity
examples.translation: 부분 게이트를 켠 상태로 인스턴스화합니다. 이러한 부분 게이트는 …
examples.suggested: fractional gates(분수 게이트)를 켠 상태로 …
examples.why: '부분 게이트' reads as 'partial gate' and is not the term IBM Quantum's Korean-reading audience will recognize; it is recoverable from context (the comment mentions non-Clifford Rx), so MINOR rather than a false concept.

examples.source: With the bounded errors from our quantum circuit, we learn the associated noise rates
examples.translation: 양자 회로에서 얻은 경계 오류를 바탕으로, 관련된 노이즈율을 학습하여
examples.suggested: 양자 회로에서 계산한, 경계가 지어진 오류들을 바탕으로 관련 노이즈율을 학습하여
examples.why: '경계 오류' most naturally parses as 'boundary error', not 'error whose effect has been bounded'; it is a calque of the English participle and a Korean technical writer would not phrase it this way.

examples.source: post-selection / two-qubit layers / Pauli twirling
examples.translation: 후선택 · 이중 큐비트 레이어 · Pauli 트월링 (Step 3–4) vs 사후 선택 · 2-큐비트 레이어 · Pauli 트와이링 (Background–Step 2)
examples.suggested: Standardize on the first-half forms: 사후 선택, 2-큐비트, 트와이링
examples.why: Three more term pairs flip at the same seam as 오차/오류, which is the clearest sign the file was produced in two passes; none of the splits hides the concept, so this stays MINOR.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every load-bearing claim survives intact, including the negation in "여분의 SWAP Gate 없이 … 배치하는 것은 불가능합니다", the cost clause in "그 대신 Circuit의 여러 인스턴스를 실행하고 고전적인 후처리를 수행합니다", the −1/+1 assignment for ⟨Z_i⟩ vs ⟨Z_i Z_{i+1}⟩, the 6^num_reps sampling-overhead statement, and the closing caveat that no error suppression/mitigation was used. The defects are consistency-level: "observable" is rendered 관측량 in Step 1 (lines 80, 84, 268-269) but 관측값 ("observed value") from Step 2 onward (293-294, 339, 440, 488, 547, 566); the step headings mix "1단계: 고전적 입력을 …" with untranslated "Step 2/Step 3/Step 4"; the BasisTranslator paragraph (line 373) suddenly writes 회로/게이트/기저 게이트 집합 in Hangul while the whole rest of the file keeps Circuit/Gate/기저 Gate 집합; and "primitives" is over-translated as 기본 요소 (392, 398, 456, 559) where 프리미티브 is the settled Korean Qiskit term. None of these would mislead a learner — register (합니다체 declaratives with 해요체 imperatives such as "참조하세요") is consistent and idiomatic for Korean technical docs.

examples.source: Output: Abstract circuit and observables
examples.translation: 출력: 추상 Circuit 및 관측량 (line 84) / 입력: 추상 Circuit과 관측값 (line 293)
examples.suggested: 관측량 (or 옵저버블) everywhere
examples.why: The same core term "observable" splits within the file, and 관측값 literally means "observed value" — a different concept from an observable operator. Recognizable from context, so MINOR, but a native editor would unify on 관측량.

examples.source: ## Step 2: Optimize problem for quantum hardware execution
examples.translation: ## 1단계: 고전적 입력을 양자 문제로 매핑하기 … ## Step 2: 양자 하드웨어 실행을 위한 문제 최적화 … ## Step 3: … ## Step 4: …
examples.suggested: 2단계: / 3단계: / 4단계:
examples.why: Step 1 is localized as 1단계 but Steps 2-4 keep the English word, so the four-step spine of the tutorial reads inconsistently in the sidebar and on the page.

examples.source: We shall apply BasisTranslator and then Optimize1qGatesDecomposition passes to ensure that all the gates in these circuits belong to the basis gate set.
examples.translation: 이 회로의 모든 게이트가 기저 게이트 집합에 속하도록 ```BasisTranslator```와 그다음 ```Optimize1qGatesDecomposition``` 패스를 적용하겠습니다.
examples.suggested: 이 Circuit의 모든 Gate가 기저 Gate 집합에 속하도록 …
examples.why: This is the only paragraph that drops the file-wide Circuit/Gate convention (used in lines 327, 369, 398, 555) for Hangul 회로/게이트, so the reader briefly sees two names for the same objects.

examples.source: Step 3: Execute using Qiskit primitives / We use a SamplerV2 primitive for execution
examples.translation: Step 3: Qiskit 기본 요소를 사용한 실행 / `SamplerV2` 기본 요소를 사용합니다
examples.suggested: Qiskit 프리미티브 / `SamplerV2` 프리미티브
examples.why: 기본 요소 ("basic element/component") is an over-translation of a term Korean Qiskit material keeps as 프리미티브; it reads as a generic component rather than the named Sampler/Estimator primitive API.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I checked every prose paragraph including the last 40% (result shapes, ZNE options, metadata, plots) and every quantity survives intact ($124$ 가상 큐비트, $12$ 매개변수 값, $2$ 외삽기, $20$ 외삽 지점, $3$ 인자, 127-Qubit, 14분, v2.0/v0.22), with no inverted condition, softened claim or hallucinated sentence; core terms are correct and stable (expectation value→기댓값, observable→관측량, extrapolation→외삽, mitigation→완화, fidelity→충실도, transpile→트랜스파일, primitives→프리미티브). What a native technical editor would still change: (1) line 58 renders "the zero-noise limit" as 영잡음 **한계** (bound/constraint) where the physics term is 영잡음 **극한** — recognizable, but the wrong sense of "limit"; (2) "parameter" is split within the file — 매개변수 값 at lines 619/775/790 vs 파라미터 값 at line 675 — and "list" likewise splits 목록 (675) vs 리스트 (782); (3) circuit/qubit/gate alternate between the kept-English forms (Circuit 잡음 line 54, 127-Qubit Backend line 545, 2-Qubit Gate line 88) and Korean 회로/큐비트/게이트 in the Step-2 block (lines 635–648), so the same concept changes shape mid-document; (4) the van den Berg citation title is translated into Korean at line 91 (희소 파울리-린드블라드 모델을…) and labelled 참고 문헌, while the Kim et al. citation at line 39 keeps both the English title and the English "**Reference**" label — citations should not be translated, and certainly not inconsistently; (5) line 648 "패스 매니저를 생성한 후 회로에 실행하여" is a calque of "run the pass manager on the circuit" (natural: 회로에 대해 실행하여 / 회로에 적용하여). Register is consistent 합니다체 declarative + 하세요/참고하세요 imperative with no 하십시오체 or 드리 humble forms. None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: 3. Extrapolate back to the zero-noise limit $\langle A(0)\rangle$
examples.translation: 3. 영잡음 한계 $\langle A(0)\rangle$으로 외삽합니다.
examples.suggested: 3. 영잡음 극한 $\langle A(0)\rangle$으로 외삽합니다.
examples.why: "limit" here is the mathematical/physical limit (극한), not a bound or constraint (한계). 영잡음 한계 reads as "the zero-noise threshold" — recognizable in context but the wrong sense of the term for a physics tutorial.

examples.source: It is done to *broadcast* with parameter values so that each qubit observable is measured for each theta value.
examples.translation: 이는 파라미터 값과 *브로드캐스트*하여 각 큐비트 관측량이 각 theta 값에 대해 측정되도록 하기 위해 수행됩니다.
examples.suggested: 이는 매개변수 값과 *브로드캐스트*하여 …
examples.why: "parameter" is 매개변수 everywhere else in the file (line 619 '나중에 할당할 매개변수 값 목록', line 790 '$12$개의 매개변수 값') but 파라미터 here; 'list' likewise splits 목록 (line 675) vs 리스트 (line 782 '리스트 형태의 구조').

examples.source: Amplify circuit noise… / a 127-qubit backend / Pick a qubit layout… translate the gates in our circuit
examples.translation: Circuit 잡음을 증폭합니다 / 127-Qubit Backend / 회로의 가상 큐비트를 … 회로의 게이트를 …
examples.suggested: Pick one convention per term and hold it for the whole page (e.g. 회로 / 큐비트 / 게이트 throughout, or the kept-English forms throughout).
examples.why: The same three core terms change shape mid-document: circuit is 'Circuit' in the Background/Setup sections and 회로 in the Step-2 block, qubit is 'Qubit' at lines 545/775/966 and 큐비트 at 560/637/673, gate is 'Gate' at 71/88 and 게이트 at 76/639/643. Not misleading — the concept stays identifiable — but jarring for a reader.

examples.source: **Reference**: E. van den Berg, Z. Minev, A. Kandala, and K. Temme, *Probabilistic error cancellation with sparse Pauli-Lindblad models on noisy quantum processors*
examples.translation: **참고 문헌**: E. van den Berg, Z. Minev, A. Kandala, and K. Temme, *희소 파울리-린드블라드 모델을 사용한 잡음 양자 프로세서에서의 확률적 오류 상쇄*
examples.suggested: **참고 문헌**: E. van den Berg, Z. Minev, A. Kandala, and K. Temme, *Probabilistic error cancellation with sparse Pauli-Lindblad models on noisy quantum processors*
examples.why: A cited paper title should stay in the language it was published in so the reader can search for it; the Kim et al. citation eight lines earlier (line 39) correctly keeps both the English title and the English '**Reference**' label, so the page is inconsistent with itself.

examples.source: Transpile your circuit for the chosen backend by creating a pass manager and then running the pass manager on the circuit.
examples.translation: 패스 매니저를 생성한 후 회로에 실행하여 선택한 Backend에 맞게 회로를 트랜스파일합니다.
examples.suggested: 패스 매니저를 생성한 다음 이를 회로에 적용하여 선택한 Backend에 맞게 회로를 트랜스파일합니다.
examples.why: '회로에 실행하여' is a word-for-word calque of English 'run … on the circuit'; Korean does not take 에 with 실행하다 this way. A native technical writer would write 회로에 대해 실행하여 or 회로에 적용하여.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination. I re-checked every load-bearing claim: the PQK advantage paragraph keeps every hedge ("잠재적인 이점", "가능성이 있습니다"), the appendix criteria survive intact (geometric separation ≈ √N, classical complexity on the order of N vs. quantum-projected "N보다 훨씬 작다면"), the 80-minute QPU caveat and the `run_experiment` flag instructions are complete, and the ZNE/error-mitigation and 1-RDM explanations match. Three things a native technical editor would still change: (1) "near-term" is rendered as the stiff calque "근시일 내" twice ("근시일 내(near-term) 양자 하드웨어", "근시일 내 장치") where Korean quantum writing says "근미래" or keeps "NISQ/near-term"; (2) "reshape … into two-dimensional arrays" becomes the vaguer "2차원 배열로 변환해야 합니다" (reshape ≠ convert; "재구성" is the precise term); (3) a register slip in Next steps — "살펴보시기 바랍니다" is honorific-request phrasing inside a file that is otherwise plain 합니다체/하세요체 ("확인하세요", "출력합니다"). None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: PQKs offer potential advantages over standard quantum kernels, particularly for near-term quantum hardware. … while remaining more practical for near-term devices.
examples.translation: PQK는 특히 근시일 내(near-term) 양자 하드웨어에서 … 근시일 내 장치에 더 실용적으로 활용될 수 있습니다.
examples.suggested: PQK는 특히 근미래(near-term) 양자 하드웨어에서 … 근미래 장치에서 더 실용적입니다.
examples.why: '근시일 내' is a colloquial time expression ('within a few days') and reads as a calque when used to modify hardware; Korean quantum documentation uses 근미래 or keeps near-term/NISQ. Meaning is still recoverable, so MINOR.

examples.source: First, we simply need to reshape the new projected training and test datasets into two-dimensional arrays.
examples.translation: 우선, 새롭게 투영된 훈련 및 테스트 데이터셋을 2차원 배열로 변환해야 합니다.
examples.suggested: 우선, 새롭게 투영된 훈련 및 테스트 데이터셋을 2차원 배열로 재구성(reshape)하기만 하면 됩니다.
examples.why: reshape is a shape change, not a data conversion; '변환' is the word already used for the one-hot/binary encoding step, so reusing it here blurs two different operations. Also drops the 'simply … just need to' lightness of the English.

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material:
examples.translation: 이 내용이 흥미로우셨다면, 다음 자료도 살펴보시기 바랍니다:
examples.suggested: 이 내용이 흥미로우셨다면, 다음 자료도 살펴보세요:
examples.why: '-시기 바랍니다' is a formal request register that clashes with the rest of the file's plain instructional voice ('확인하세요', '건너뛰어도 됩니다'). A single-point slip, not a systematic problem.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful end-to-end — no inverted conditions, swapped quantities, dropped caveats or hallucinated claims; the delicate passages (non-monotonicity of max_err_terms/max_obs_terms, the "measure only the top 30 terms but let O-tilde grow large" caveat, the Clifford-angle difficulty claim, the optimization_level=0 rationale, noise_scales=0.0) all survive intact. The defects are editorial. (1) "two-qubit" splits three ways within the file: 이중 큐비트 (frontmatter, §배경, §소규모 시뮬레이터), 2-큐비트 (학습 목표), and 2-Qubit (from 2단계 onward); "qubit" likewise appears as 큐비트 / 큐빗 (line 647) / Qubit, "randomization" as 무작위화 (early) then 랜덤화 (§QuantumProgram onward), "kicked Ising" as 킥된 이징 vs 킥드 이징, and "workflow" as 워크플로우 vs 워크플로. (2) "spectator ... measurements" is rendered 관찰자 측정, which reads as a human observer rather than the neighboring spectator qubits. (3) Register wobbles: 보여드립니다 (humble, line 42) and 하십시오체 imperatives (고려하십시오, 기억하십시오, 참조하십시오) sit against 확인하세요 elsewhere. (4) Two stiff calques: "의미 있는 유사물이 없는" for "no meaningful analog", and "매핑하는 작업을 구축합니다" for "we build a mapping".

examples.source: two-qubit gate noise / two-qubit gate layers
examples.translation: 2-큐비트 게이트 노이즈 (L22) / 이중 큐비트 게이트 (L46, L238) / 2-Qubit Gate 레이어 (L301, L371)
examples.suggested: Pick one and use it throughout — 2-큐비트 게이트 (with 큐비트 also replacing 큐빗 at L647)
examples.why: The same concept is spelled three different ways within one tutorial; a learner scanning for '이중 큐비트' in Step 2 will not find it. Recognizable, so MINOR, but a native editor would unify it.

examples.source: we also add spectator and post-selection measurements
examples.translation: 여기서는 ... 관찰자 및 후선택 측정도 추가합니다
examples.suggested: 스펙테이터(주변 큐비트) 측정 및 후선택 측정
examples.why: '관찰자' reads as a human observer; 'spectator' here denotes the idle neighbor qubits measured to detect crosstalk. The reader can still infer it from the code (AddSpectatorMeasures), so it does not mislead, but the term is wrong.

examples.source: we demonstrate how to leverage ... / also consider the following / See the pauli-prop docs for more information
examples.translation: 보여드립니다 (L42); 고려하십시오 (L582); 기억하십시오 (L588); 참조하십시오 (L590, L649)
examples.suggested: 보여줍니다 / 고려하세요 / 기억하세요 / 참조하세요 — matching 확인하세요 at L110
examples.why: The file mixes the humble 드리 form and 하십시오체 imperatives with the 해요체 used elsewhere (확인하세요, L110). A few slips only, so MINOR.

examples.source: two hardware services that have no meaningful analog on an ideal simulator
examples.translation: 이상적인 시뮬레이터에서는 의미 있는 유사물이 없는 두 가지 하드웨어 서비스
examples.suggested: 이상적인 시뮬레이터에는 이에 대응하는 것이 없는 두 가지 하드웨어 서비스
examples.why: '유사물' is a dictionary rendering of 'analog' that no Korean technical writer would use here; 대응물/대응하는 것 is the idiomatic choice. Grammatical and understandable — style only.

examples.source: we build a mapping from each InjectNoise.ref to its corresponding learned noise model
examples.translation: 각 `InjectNoise.ref`를 해당 학습된 노이즈 모델(`PauliLindbladMap`)에 매핑하는 작업을 구축합니다
examples.suggested: 각 `InjectNoise.ref`를 해당 학습된 노이즈 모델(`PauliLindbladMap`)에 대응시키는 매핑을 구성합니다
examples.why: '매핑하는 작업을 구축' collides two nouns ('작업' + '구축') where the English builds a mapping object; the sentence reads as MT even though the meaning survives.

examples.source: noise rates / error rates
examples.translation: 노이즈 비율 (heading, L493) alongside 오류율 (L495) and 오류율 (L498)
examples.suggested: 노이즈율 / 노이즈 발생률, to match 오류율
examples.why: '비율' means ratio/proportion; the quantity plotted is a rate, and the same paragraph already uses the -율 suffix for 오류율. Defensible but inconsistent inside one section.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveat, no hallucination; the quantitative claims (분수 2-Qubit 게이트 $R_{ZZ}$의 세 레이어, 역전파로 두 레이어 감소, 9번째 단계 QPU 5분 제한 → 15분 실행 시 오차 막대 축소) all track the English, and the deliberately odd EN "four circuits with 5, 7, and 9 Trotter steps" is mirrored rather than silently corrected. What a native technical editor would change is consistency: "magnetization" is 자화 in the Background bullet and Step 1 but 자기화 in the closing plot sentence; "noisy" alternates between 잡음 (잡음 인식 트랜스파일, 잔류 잡음, 잡음 있는 결과) and 노이즈 (노이즈가 있는 기댓값); "device" alternates 장치/디바이스; and "estimation" alternates 추정/예측 inside Step 2. Two wording slips: the Step 4 heading renders "classical format" as "클래식 형식" (클래식 = classical music in Korean) while Step 1 correctly uses 고전적 입력, and "possibly non-commuting observables" comes out as the calqued "가능하게 비교환하는 관측량 집합". Headings 1단계/2단계 are translated but Step 3/Step 4 are left in English. None of this misleads a learner.

examples.source: plot the magnetization versus the number of steps
examples.translation: 단계 수에 따른 자기화(magnetization)를 플롯할 수 있습니다
examples.suggested: 단계 수에 따른 자화(magnetization)를 플롯할 수 있습니다
examples.why: Earlier occurrences use 자화 (오류 완화가 자화(magnetization)에 미치는 영향, 평균 자화 관측량); the closing sentence switches to 자기화 for the same quantity. 자화 is the standard Korean physics term — pick one.

examples.source: Step 4: Post-process and return result in desired classical format
examples.translation: Step 4: 결과를 원하는 클래식 형식으로 후처리 및 반환
examples.suggested: 4단계: 결과를 원하는 고전적 형식으로 후처리 및 반환
examples.why: 클래식 reads as 'classic/classical music' in Korean, not 'classical (non-quantum)'; Step 1's heading already renders the same word correctly as 고전적 입력. Also, 1단계/2단계 are translated while Step 3/Step 4 are left in English.

examples.source: noisy / noise-aware transpilation / residual noise
examples.translation: 잡음 인식 트랜스파일 … 잔류 잡음 … vs 노이즈가 있는 기댓값 … 노이즈가 있는 양자 장치
examples.suggested: pick one of 잡음 / 노이즈 and use it for every occurrence
examples.why: The same concept is split between 잡음 and 노이즈 within one page; the ideal/noisy/mitigated comparison is the pedagogical spine of the tutorial, so one label should carry through.

examples.source: OBP will generally return a set of possibly non-commuting observables.
examples.translation: OBP는 일반적으로 가능하게 비교환하는 관측량 집합을 반환합니다.
examples.suggested: OBP는 일반적으로 서로 교환하지 않을 수도 있는 관측량 집합을 반환합니다.
examples.why: '가능하게 비교환하는' is a word-for-word calque of 'possibly non-commuting'; a Korean quantum engineer would write 서로 교환하지 않을 수 있는 (or 비가환일 수 있는), not the adverb 가능하게.

examples.source: time estimation
examples.translation: OBP 적용 전후 QPU 시간 예측 … 분석적 시간 예측 … 경험적 시간 예측 … 시간 추정값을 출력합니다
examples.suggested: use 시간 추정 consistently (as in the Background bullet and 사용 시간 추정)
examples.why: Step 2 mixes 예측 (prediction) and 추정 (estimation) for the same QESEM feature within four lines, and the Background section already established 시간 추정.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no dropped caveat, no hallucination: the Premium-Plan/Open-Plan swap note, the $b_i = 0$ / $Q_{ij}=1$ unweighted reduction, the COBYLA convergence-diagnosis paragraph and the brute-force cross-check are all rendered completely and correctly, and core terms are correct and consistent (Hamiltonian→비용 Hamiltonian, ansatz→ansatz, transpile→트랜스파일, primitives→프리미티브, shots→샷, superposition→중첩, session→session). Three editor-level nits remain. (1) "best cut" is consistently rendered as 최적의 컷 / 최적 컷 ("the optimal cut") rather than 최선의/가장 좋은 컷 — a mild strengthening in a tutorial whose whole point is comparing QAOA's found cut against the true classical optimum. (2) "Despite the 'small-scale' label" becomes "'소규모'라는 라벨에도 불구하고", an English-shaped calque a Korean technical writer would phrase as "'소규모'라는 이름과 달리". (3) "the optimizer wanders" becomes "최적화기가 방황하게 됩니다", where 방황 carries an emotional/literary connotation that is off-register for an optimizer trajectory. Register is fine: 해요체 imperatives (참고하세요, 선택하세요) with standard 합니다 declaratives, no 하십시오체 or humble 드리 forms.

examples.source: This represents the best cut found by QAOA.
examples.translation: 이는 QAOA가 찾은 최적의 컷을 나타냅니다.
examples.suggested: 이는 QAOA가 찾아낸 가장 좋은 컷을 나타냅니다.
examples.why: 최적 = 'optimal', which the English deliberately avoids: the section immediately after this compares the QAOA cut against the brute-force optimum, so calling QAOA's sample 'optimal' pre-empts that comparison. Same rendering recurs in the heading 최적 컷 시각화 (KO 373) and in Step 4 최적 컷을 추출 (KO 604).

examples.source: Despite the "small-scale" label, this example still runs on real IBM Quantum hardware
examples.translation: "소규모"라는 라벨에도 불구하고, 이 예제는 여전히 실제 IBM Quantum 하드웨어에서 실행됩니다
examples.suggested: "소규모"라는 이름과 달리 이 예제도 실제 IBM Quantum 하드웨어에서 실행됩니다
examples.why: 라벨에도 불구하고 is a word-for-word transfer of 'despite the label'; Korean technical prose uses ~와 달리 / ~이지만 here. 여전히 for 'still' also reads as a temporal 'still', not the concessive 'nonetheless' the English means.

examples.source: its linear-approximation model can no longer tell real descent from random jitter and the optimizer wanders
examples.translation: 선형 근사 모델이 더 이상 실제 하강과 무작위 흔들림을 구분할 수 없게 되어 최적화기가 방황하게 됩니다
examples.suggested: …구분하지 못해 최적화가 엉뚱한 방향으로 헤매게 됩니다
examples.why: 방황하다 describes a person wandering aimlessly in a life sense; applied to an optimizer it reads as literary translationese. 헤매다 or 엉뚱한 방향으로 움직이다 is the phrasing a Korean quantum/ML engineer would write. Meaning is preserved, so this is style only.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — every load-bearing caveat survives intact (the MEM caveat "실시간 피드포워드가 이미 사용한 중간 회로 측정 결과를 소급하여 변경할 수는 없습니다", the "독립적인 DD 대 비-DD 비교로 해석해서는 안 됩니다" warning, the "논문의 FC-DD 프로토콜로 표시해서는 안 됩니다" qualifier, and the 80%/10%/10% scoring weights), and no hallucinated sentence appears. What a native editor would change is mechanical: (1) in the Figure-2a paragraph the modifier is misplaced — "1024 샷으로 더 적은 최신 장치인 `ibm_aachen`" can be misread as "a smaller modern device", where the English says only that the *shot count* is smaller; (2) the register is split — 하십시오체 in the early sections ("비교해 보십시오", "설치하십시오", "줄이십시오", "늘리십시오") vs. 해요체 in 다음 단계 ("참고하세요", "실험해 보세요"); (3) core terms flip form mid-file: Qubit→큐비트, Backend→백엔드, Circuit→회로, "Orbit Function 작업"→"Orbit 함수 작업", and mid-circuit measurement is rendered "회로 중간 측정" in 배경 but "중간 회로 측정" in the results section; (4) "전-대-전 2-Qubit Gate" is a hyphenated calque of all-to-all that no Korean technical writer would produce; (5) "`N_VALUES`의 최댓값을 줄이세요" narrows the English plural "the largest values" to a single maximum.

examples.source: we use a modern device `ibm_aachen` with a smaller 1024-shot count to preserve QPU time
examples.translation: 우리는 QPU 시간을 절약하기 위해 1024 샷으로 더 적은 최신 장치인 `ibm_aachen`을 사용합니다.
examples.suggested: 우리는 QPU 시간을 절약하려고 최신 장치인 `ibm_aachen`을 더 적은 1024 샷으로 사용해요.
examples.why: ‘더 적은’ sits between ‘1024 샷으로’ and ‘최신 장치’, so the sentence can be parsed as ibm_aachen being the *smaller* device rather than the shot count being smaller. Recoverable, but the modifier belongs on 샷.

examples.source: make sure to compare these results … / Install the most recent versions … / Reduce `N_VALUES` or `M`
examples.translation: 비교해 보십시오 / 설치하십시오 / 줄이십시오 … 늘리십시오  —  but later: 참고하세요 / 실험해 보세요 / 줄이세요
examples.suggested: 비교해 보세요 / 설치하세요 / 줄이세요 / 늘리세요
examples.why: The file starts in 하십시오체 and switches to 해요체 from 다음 단계 onward; the house convention for this tutorial series is 해요체 throughout.

examples.source: mid-circuit measurements … a mid-circuit measurement result
examples.translation: 회로 중간 측정 (배경) vs 중간 회로 측정 (결과 검색 절)
examples.suggested: Pick one — 회로 중간 측정 — and use it in both places.
examples.why: The same concept is named two ways inside one page; the concept is still identifiable, so this is a consistency slip rather than a meaning error. The same split affects Qubit/큐비트, Backend/백엔드, Circuit/회로 and 'Orbit Function 작업'/'Orbit 함수 작업'.

examples.source: The dynamic form removes the all-to-all two-qubit-gate requirement
examples.translation: 동적 형태는 전-대-전 2-Qubit Gate 요구 사항을 제거하고
examples.suggested: 동적 형태는 모든 큐비트 쌍 사이에 2-큐비트 게이트가 필요하다는 요구 사항을 없애고
examples.why: ‘전-대-전’ is a hyphen-for-hyphen calque of all-to-all that is not idiomatic Korean technical usage; the intended 'every pair of qubits' sense is left for the reader to reconstruct.

examples.source: increase `NUM_BATCH_JOBS`, reduce `M`, or reduce the largest values in `N_VALUES`
examples.translation: `NUM_BATCH_JOBS`를 늘리거나, `M`을 줄이거나, `N_VALUES`의 최댓값을 줄이세요.
examples.suggested: … `N_VALUES`에서 큰 값들을 줄이세요.
examples.why: The English advises trimming the several largest entries; 최댓값 says only the single maximum, a dropped-plural narrowing of the remediation advice.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination: the O(N^2)/quadratic-cost paragraph, "up to shot noise" → "샷 노이즈를 제외하면 정확하며", the adjoint-composition caveat ("특성 맵과 그 수반 연산자를 합성함"), the N(N+1)/2 unique-entry count and "row 15, column 20" all survive intact, and core terms are correct and consistent (feature map→특성 맵, fidelity→충실도, quasi-probability→준확률 분포, stabilizer→안정자, primitive→프리미티브, transpile→트랜스파일). What a native editor would change is the group-theory vocabulary: "group" is rendered 그룹 ("그룹 구조", "그룹과 부분군으로 형성된 두 코셋") while every neighbouring term uses the standard math 군 (부분군, 특수 유니타리 군, 군론), an in-file split in the exact passage where the reader is learning the coset construction; relatedly "left-coset" appears as the awkwardly spaced "좌 코셋" rather than 좌잉여류/왼쪽 잉여류. Two smaller polish items: the Step-4 sentence stacks 채워…채웁니다, and a learning-outcome bullet drops the English subject so it reads as "the method of providing enhanced feature spaces" rather than "how quantum kernels provide them". None of these mislead.

examples.source: The input training dataset contains a group structure, consisting of two cosets formed by a group and subgroup. … the special unitary group of 2×2 matrices
examples.translation: 입력 훈련 데이터셋에는 그룹과 부분군으로 형성된 두 코셋으로 구성된 그룹 구조가 포함되어 있습니다. … 이는 $2 \times 2$ 행렬의 특수 유니타리 군으로
examples.suggested: 입력 훈련 데이터셋에는 군과 부분군으로 형성된 두 잉여류(코셋)로 구성된 군 구조가 포함되어 있습니다.
examples.why: Within one paragraph 'group' is 그룹 while 'subgroup', 'special unitary group' and (line 42) 'group theory' use the standard mathematical 군 (부분군 / 특수 유니타리 군 / 군론). The concept stays identifiable, so it is MINOR, but a Korean technical editor would unify on 군 — 그룹 reads as a generic English loan exactly where the text is teaching the group/subgroup/coset hierarchy. Same paragraph: 'left-cosets' → '좌 코셋' (line 141) is an unidiomatic space-separated hybrid; 좌잉여류 or 왼쪽 잉여류 is conventional.

examples.source: Calculate the probability of measuring |0⟩ on the overlap circuit, and populate the kernel matrix in the position corresponding to the samples represented by this particular overlap circuit (row 15, column 20).
examples.translation: 오버랩 Circuit에서 $|0 \rangle$을 측정할 확률을 계산하고, 이 특정 오버랩 Circuit이 나타내는 샘플에 해당하는 위치(행 15, 열 20)에 값을 채워 커널 행렬을 채웁니다.
examples.suggested: 오버랩 Circuit에서 $|0 \rangle$을 측정할 확률을 계산한 뒤, 이 오버랩 Circuit이 나타내는 샘플에 해당하는 커널 행렬 위치(행 15, 열 20)에 그 값을 채웁니다.
examples.why: '값을 채워 … 커널 행렬을 채웁니다' repeats 채우다 twice in one clause chain — the English has a single 'populate'. Meaning is correct; the doubled verb is the kind of stiffness a native technical writer would not leave in.

examples.source: Quantum kernels and how they can provide enhanced feature spaces
examples.translation: 양자 커널과 향상된 특성 공간을 제공하는 방법
examples.suggested: 양자 커널, 그리고 양자 커널이 어떻게 향상된 특성 공간을 제공하는지
examples.why: Dropping the subject 'they' turns a learning outcome about what quantum kernels do into a generic 'how to provide enhanced feature spaces'. The link between the kernel and the enhanced feature space — the point of the bullet — is flattened, though the reader can still recover it from the surrounding bullets.

editor_note: Both delta entries are semantically faithful — nothing misleading. Entry 46 (the injected IBM Quantum survey note) renders the source exactly: attribution to IBM Quantum, scope limited to the tutorial content, and the doQumentation-side feedback path to a GitHub issue, in correct 해요체 ("…주세요"). The one editorial slip is entry 28: the Part 2 heading is localized as "파트 2: FeP-NO (44Q)" while its sibling at line 64 is still "Part 1: Li2S (20Q)", so the two top-level parts of the same page use different words for "Part" in the TOC and sidebar. Either localize both to 파트 or leave both as Part; the meaning and the 44Q qubit count are otherwise correct.

examples.source: Part 2: FeP-NO (44Q)
examples.translation: 파트 2: FeP-NO (44Q)
examples.suggested: Part 2: FeP-NO (44Q)  (or localize line 64 to "파트 1: Li2S (20Q)" so both match)
examples.why: Sibling top-level headings in the same file disagree: Part 1 keeps the English "Part", Part 2 uses "파트". Visible side by side in the sidebar and TOC; not misleading, but a native editor would make the pair consistent.

editor_note: "Hahn echo" is mistranslated throughout as if "Hahn" were the Korean numeral/determiner 한 ("one/a"): the $T_2$ bullet renders "A Hahn echo experiment puts each qubit in a superposition" as "한 실험은 각 큐비트를 중첩 상태로 만들고", and the experiment list renders "$T_2$ Hahn echo experiment" as "$T_2$ 한 실험". The damaging instance is in the dynamical-decoupling section: "the $T_2$ experiment applies a single Hahn echo" becomes "$T_2$ 실험은 단일 실험을 적용하고" ("applies a single experiment"), which is both false and destroys the setup for the very next sentence, "한 가지 가설은 에코 수입니다" — the reader is asked to test a hypothesis about the number of echoes without ever being told the default is one echo pulse. The named technique 한 에코 / Hahn echo therefore never reaches the learner anywhere in the prose, even though the code output blocks show "T2 (Hahn)". Secondary, non-blocking: "snapshot taken" is calqued as 촬영된 스냅샷 (literally "photographed", lines ~69 and ~373), and single-qubit alternates between 단일 큐비트 and 1큐비트 within the file. Everything else — the drift/methodology discussion, the two-qubit crosstalk explanation, the T1/T2 comparison bullets, and the closing caveat 보고된 캘리브레이션 데이터와의 차이가 자동으로 드리프트의 증거가 되는 것은 아닙니다 — is faithful and reads naturally.

examples.source: By default the $T_2$ experiment applies a single Hahn echo and measures all qubits in parallel
examples.translation: 기본적으로 $T_2$ 실험은 단일 실험을 적용하고 모든 큐비트를 병렬로 측정하는데
examples.suggested: 기본적으로 $T_2$ 실험은 한 번의 Hahn 에코(단일 에코)만 적용하고 모든 큐비트를 병렬로 측정하는데
examples.why: "applies a single Hahn echo" became "applies a single experiment" — an experiment does not apply an experiment. The dropped quantity (one echo pulse) is exactly the antecedent for the next sentence's hypothesis 한 가지 가설은 에코 수입니다, so the whole 8-echo CPMG section loses its premise.

examples.source: **$T_2$** (`t2`): A Hahn echo experiment puts each qubit in a superposition, applies an echo pulse halfway through a delay
examples.translation: **$T_2$** (`t2`): 한 실험은 각 큐비트를 중첩 상태로 만들고, 지연 시간의 중간에 에코 펄스를 적용하며
examples.suggested: **$T_2$** (`t2`): Hahn 에코 실험은 각 큐비트를 중첩 상태로 만들고, 지연 시간의 중간에 에코 펄스를 적용하며
examples.why: The proper name "Hahn" was absorbed into Korean 한 ("a/one"), so the sentence reads "one experiment puts each qubit..." and the standard name of the T2 measurement technique is never taught.

examples.source: - `t2`: $T_2$ Hahn echo experiment (a single echo by default)
examples.translation: - `t2`: $T_2$ 한 실험 (기본적으로 단일 에코)
examples.suggested: - `t2`: $T_2$ Hahn 에코 실험 (기본적으로 단일 에코)
examples.why: Same Hahn→한 collapse in the experiment-selection list; "$T_2$ 한 실험" is not parseable Korean for a technique name, and the reader cannot connect it to the "T2 (Hahn)" strings in the code output below.

examples.source: The measured values are a snapshot taken with a particular methodology. / a self-consistent snapshot taken under conditions close to a real workload
examples.translation: 측정된 값은 특정 방법론으로 촬영된 스냅샷입니다. / 실제 워크로드에 가까운 조건에서 촬영된 자기 일관적인 스냅샷
examples.suggested: 특정 방법론으로 취득한 스냅샷입니다 / 실제 워크로드에 가까운 조건에서 얻은 자기 일관적인 스냅샷
examples.why: 촬영하다 means "to photograph/film"; a Korean technical writer would use 취득한/얻은 for measurement data. Meaning survives, but it reads as literal MT of "taken".

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no drift, no hallucination, no dropped caveat; the load-bearing claims all survive intact (SQD 성능 보장 조건 "바닥 상태가 희소한 경우...에만 보장됩니다", 상한값 보장 "실제 바닥 상태 에너지의 상한값임이 보장됩니다", the position/momentum-basis motivation, and the Trotter/Krylov construction). The defects are editorial. (1) The initial-state sentence is grammatically broken: "페르미 준위에 가장 가까운 세 전자를 가장 가까운 4개의 빈 모드로 가능한 모든 여기시키는 중첩으로 주어지며" — "가능한 모든 여기" is a noun phrase that then takes a verb ending "여기시키는"; a native writer would write "…빈 모드로 여기시키는 가능한 모든 상태의 중첩". (2) "bitstring" is rendered two ways in the same file: 비트열 (learning outcomes, Background) vs 비트 문자열 (Step 3 prose). (3) The step headings are half-translated and inconsistent: "1단계: 문제를 양자 Circuit으로 매핑하기" but then "Step 2:", "Step 3:", "Step 4:"; "circuit" itself alternates between the kept English Circuit and 회로 within the same paragraph (e.g. 배경 "양자 회로" / "이러한 회로" vs 학습 성과 "시간 진화 Circuit"). (4) A few calques in the closing prose ("다음 자료들도 관심을 가질 수 있습니다"). None of these would mislead a learner.

examples.source: the initial state $\ket{\psi_0}$ is given by the superposition of all possible excitations of the three electrons closest to the Fermi level into the 4 closest empty modes
examples.translation: 초기 상태 $\ket{\psi_0}$는 … 페르미 준위에 가장 가까운 세 전자를 가장 가까운 4개의 빈 모드로 가능한 모든 여기시키는 중첩으로 주어지며
examples.suggested: 초기 상태 $\ket{\psi_0}$는 … 페르미 준위에 가장 가까운 세 전자를 가장 가까운 4개의 빈 모드로 여기시키는, 가능한 모든 상태의 중첩으로 주어지며
examples.why: '가능한 모든 여기'(noun) is spliced onto the verb form '여기시키는', so the phrase is ungrammatical; the reader has to reconstruct that it is a superposition OF all possible excitations, not a superposition that excites everything.

examples.source: bitstrings sampled from a quantum processing unit … the top 20 most commonly sampled bitstrings
examples.translation: 양자 처리 장치(QPU)에서 샘플링한 비트열 … 가장 많이 샘플링된 상위 20개 비트 문자열
examples.suggested: 비트열 (throughout)
examples.why: The same term is rendered 비트열 in the learning outcomes and Background but 비트 문자열 in Step 3; a learner tracking the SQD data flow sees two names for one object.

examples.source: ### Step 1: Map problem to a quantum circuit … ### Step 2: Optimize problem for quantum execution
examples.translation: ### 1단계: 문제를 양자 Circuit으로 매핑하기 … ### Step 2: 양자 실행을 위한 문제 최적화
examples.suggested: ### 2단계: 양자 실행을 위한 문제 최적화 (and 3단계 / 4단계)
examples.why: Step 1 is localized as '1단계' while Steps 2–4 keep the English 'Step'; the four-step Qiskit patterns section reads as two different documents stitched together.

examples.source: If you found this work interesting, you might be interested in the following material:
examples.translation: 이 작업이 흥미로우셨다면, 다음 자료들도 관심을 가질 수 있습니다:
examples.suggested: 이 내용이 흥미로우셨다면, 다음 자료도 함께 살펴보세요:
examples.why: '관심을 가질 수 있습니다' is a literal calque of 'you might be interested'; Korean technical writing uses a suggestion form here, and '작업' reads oddly for 'this work' meaning the tutorial content.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no semantic drift, no dropped caveat and no hallucination: the tricky passages all survive intact (the Hamming-weight/valid-configuration definition with right half = spin-up, left half = spin-down; "the fraction will be less than one, but hopefully larger than…uniformly at random"; the `initial_occupancies` caveat "without this argument…would fail and raise an error"; and "the final accuracy might be worse" → "최종 정확도가 더 낮을 수 있습니다"). The defects are terminology consistency. (1) "orbital" is 오비탈/공간 오비탈 for most of the file (lines 73, 79, 81, 87) but switches to 궤도/공간 궤도 in the final "결과 시각화" paragraph (line 437) — and bare 궤도 means "orbit", not 오비탈/궤도함수. (2) "ground state" is rendered both 기저 상태 (lines 22, 45, 79, 85) and 바닥 상태 (lines 273, 333), and 기저 상태 is simultaneously used for "basis states" in line 48 ("기저 상태 집합 $\mathcal{S}$"), where the neighbouring 기저 벡터 (line 85) shows 기저 = basis; each instance is disambiguated by context, but the collision is avoidable. (3) "noisy" is 잡음 있는 everywhere except 노이즈가 있는 at line 333. (4) "Hamming weight" is a literal calque 해밍 무게 (standard Korean is 해밍 가중치), used consistently.

examples.source: The second plot shows the average occupancy of each spatial orbital after the final iteration. We can see that both the spin-up and spin-down electrons occupy the first five orbitals with high probability in our solutions.
examples.translation: 두 번째 플롯은 마지막 반복 후 각 공간 궤도의 평균 점유율을 보여줍니다. 스핀-업 전자와 스핀-다운 전자 모두 우리의 솔루션에서 높은 확률로 처음 다섯 개의 궤도를 점유하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다.
examples.suggested: 두 번째 플롯은 마지막 반복 후 각 공간 오비탈의 평균 점유율을 보여줍니다. … 높은 확률로 처음 다섯 개의 오비탈을 점유하고 …
examples.why: The rest of the file consistently uses 오비탈/공간 오비탈 (lines 73, 79, 81, 87); only this closing paragraph switches to 궤도, which on its own reads as "orbit" (Bohr orbit) rather than an orbital. Concept still recoverable, so MINOR.

examples.source: …collect samples for ground state energy estimation. / Now, we estimate the ground state energy of the Hamiltonian…
examples.translation: …바닥 상태 에너지 추정을 위한 샘플을 수집할 준비가 됩니다. / 이제 … 해밀토니안의 바닥 상태 에너지를 추정합니다.
examples.suggested: …기저 상태 에너지 추정을 위한 샘플을 … / …해밀토니안의 기저 상태 에너지를 추정합니다.
examples.why: "Ground state" is 기저 상태 in the learning outcomes, background and the recovery-procedure steps, but 바닥 상태 in Steps 3 and 4. Both are legitimate Korean, but the file should pick one.

examples.source: the wave function is supported in a set of basis states $\mathcal{S} = \{|x\rangle\}$ whose size does not increase exponentially
examples.translation: 파동 함수가 문제 크기에 따라 지수적으로 증가하지 않는 기저 상태 집합 $\mathcal{S} = \{|x\rangle \}$에 의해 지지될 때 효과적입니다.
examples.suggested: 파동 함수가 … 기저 상태(basis state) 집합 $\mathcal{S}$ 위에서 지지(support)를 가질 때 …
examples.why: 기저 상태 is used elsewhere in this same file to mean "ground state", so "기저 상태 집합" momentarily reads as "a set of ground states"; the ket notation and the 기저 벡터 of step 3 disambiguate it, so this is a consistency slip rather than a misleading statement.

examples.source: This function performs the self-consistent configuration recovery procedure to iteratively refine the noisy quantum samples…
examples.translation: 이 함수는 자기 일관적 구성 복구 절차를 수행하여 노이즈가 있는 양자 샘플을 반복적으로 개선함으로써 …
examples.suggested: … 잡음 있는 양자 샘플을 반복적으로 개선함으로써 …
examples.why: Every other occurrence of "noisy" in the file is 잡음 있는 (lines 35, 79, 317, 335, 435); this single 노이즈가 있는 breaks the convention.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the order-finding/phase-estimation derivation, the |1> = uniform-superposition-of-eigenstates argument, the "k=0 또는 k와 r이 서로소가 아니어서 r 대신 r의 약수" failure explanation, and the even-r / "그렇지 않다면 ... 진약수일 확률이 높습니다" branch all track the English exactly, so nothing here would teach a false concept. The main defect is terminology drift within the file: "order finding" is 위수 찾기 for the first ~60% (lines 41, 74, 87–98), silently becomes 차수 찾기 from line 377 onward ("전체 차수 찾기 회로", "차수(r)", "Shor의 차수 찾기 알고리즘"), reverts to "위수 찾기 Circuit" at line 558, and is left untranslated as "order finding 문제" / "Shor's algorithm을" in the Step-4 opener (line 611); 차수 normally means "degree" in Korean math, where 위수 is the right word for the order of a group element. Smaller items: the scaling paragraph inflates "a circuit depth on the order of a billion" to "수십억 수준의 Circuit 깊이" and adds an intensifier ("한계를 훨씬 초과", line 674) that the English does not have; "feed-forward operations" is rendered "순방향 연산" (line 668), which a reader will not connect to measurement-conditioned control; "by inspection" is calqued as "검사를 통해" (line 286) where the same file elsewhere correctly uses 관찰. Register is consistent 합니다체 (defensible for Korean technical docs) apart from one humble slip, "보여드리겠습니다" (line 612).

examples.source: order finding problem / full order finding circuit / So far, we discussed how we can implement the order finding problem
examples.translation: 위수 찾기 문제(order finding problem) … 전체 차수 찾기 회로 … 지금까지 위상 추정 circuit을 사용하여 order finding 문제를 구현하는 방법을 논의했습니다
examples.suggested: Use 위수 찾기 everywhere (위수 찾기 회로, 위수 r, 위수 찾기를 위한 쇼어 알고리즘) and translate the Step-4 opener: "지금까지 위상 추정 회로를 사용하여 위수 찾기 문제를 구현하는 방법을 논의했습니다. 이제 위수 찾기 문제를 정수 인수분해와 연결하여 쇼어 알고리즘을 완성하겠습니다."
examples.why: The same concept appears under three labels in one tutorial — 위수 찾기, 차수 찾기, and bare English "order finding". 차수 is the standard Korean word for the degree of a polynomial, not the order of an element of Z*_N, so a reader who meets 차수 찾기 at line 378 after 90 lines of 위수 찾기 may not realize it is the same problem.

examples.source: will result in a quantum circuit with millions of qubits, including the error correction overhead and a circuit depth on the order of a billion, which is beyond the limits of current quantum hardware to execute
examples.translation: 수백만 개의 Qubit과 수십억 수준의 Circuit 깊이가 필요한 양자 Circuit이 요구되며, 이는 현재 양자 하드웨어의 실행 한계를 훨씬 초과합니다
examples.suggested: … 수백만 개의 큐비트와 10억 규모의 회로 깊이가 필요한 양자 회로가 요구되며, 이는 현재 양자 하드웨어의 실행 한계를 넘어섭니다
examples.why: Two small unforced changes to a quantitative claim: "on the order of a billion" (10억 규모) is inflated to 수십억 (billions/tens of billions), and "beyond the limits" gains an intensifier 훨씬 that the English does not carry.

examples.source: requires mid-circuit measurements with feed-forward operations and qubit recycling with reset operations
examples.translation: 순방향 연산을 통한 중간 Circuit 측정과 초기화 연산을 통한 qubit 재활용이 필요합니다
examples.suggested: 피드포워드(feed-forward) 연산을 동반한 중간 회로 측정과 리셋 연산을 통한 큐비트 재활용이 필요합니다
examples.why: "순방향 연산" reads as "forward operation" and loses the actual meaning — applying later gates conditioned on a mid-circuit measurement outcome. The field keeps 피드포워드 (usually with the English in parentheses).

examples.source: we were able to synthesize these operations directly with SWAP gates by inspection
examples.translation: 검사를 통해 ``SWAP`` 게이트를 사용하여 이러한 연산을 직접 합성할 수 있었습니다
examples.suggested: 눈으로 살펴보는 것만으로 ``SWAP`` 게이트를 사용해 이러한 연산을 직접 합성할 수 있었습니다
examples.why: 검사 is a calque of "inspection" that in Korean suggests a testing/verification step. Elsewhere in the same file "By observation" is correctly rendered 관찰에 의하면 (lines 95, 116), so this is also internally inconsistent.

examples.source: We now demonstrate this using our example of N = 15 and a = 2.
examples.translation: 이제 $N = 15$이고 $a = 2$인 예제를 사용하여 이를 보여드리겠습니다.
examples.suggested: 이제 $N = 15$, $a = 2$인 예제를 사용하여 이를 살펴보겠습니다.
examples.why: 보여드리다 is the humble (드리-) form, a slip out of the plain 합니다체 the rest of the tutorial keeps (보여줍니다 / 살펴보겠습니다). A single instance, so cosmetic only.

editor_note: No misleading content: every number, condition and caveat survives (0.82 vs 0.98 fidelity, ~0.65 at 50 sites, 3+2 / 6+4 compression plans, "estimator_options replaces the defaults wholesale", the mirror-symmetry and clip-negatives rationale, the ~4h classical vs ~18 min QPU contrast). What a native editor would change: (1) "twirling" is transliterated as 트와이어링 ("Pauli 트와이어링", "게이트 트와이어링", "트와이어된 판독 오류 소거") — consistent, but the conventional rendering is 트월링/트월링(twirling); recognizable, not concept-breaking. (2) 나머지 is attached to the total rather than the remainder in both compression paragraphs — "나머지 10개의 Trotter 단계 중 다섯 개" / "나머지 20단계 중 10단계" reads as "the remaining 10/20 steps, of which five/ten…", where EN says "the remaining five of the 10 steps". (3) "큐 대기 시간은 이 두 시간에 추가됩니다" for "Queue wait is on top of both" is ambiguous — 두 시간 reads as "two hours" rather than "both of those times". Plus smaller slips: Serverless 워커 vs 서버리스 워커 within the same file, the calque "기본적인 노출" for "basic exposure", "쌍의 분수화된 스피논" (should be 분수화된 스피논 쌍), "adapted from" flattened to "가져온 것입니다", and one humble-form slip 저희 in the long-run admonition.

examples.source: dynamical decoupling, Pauli twirling, and twirled readout error extinction (TREX)
examples.translation: 동적 디커플링, Pauli 트와이어링, 트와이어된 판독 오류 소거(TREX)
examples.suggested: 동적 디커플링, Pauli 트월링, 트월링된 판독 오류 소거(TREX)
examples.why: 'twirling' is mis-transliterated as 트와이어링 ('twiring'); the field's Korean transliteration is 트월링. Consistent within the file and still recognizable from the Pauli/TREX context, so imperfect rather than false.

examples.source: here we compress the first three steps into a single-layer ansatz and the next two into a deeper two-layer ansatz; the remaining five of the 10 Trotter steps run as plain Trotter
examples.translation: 여기서는 처음 세 단계를 단일 계층 앤사츠로, 다음 두 단계를 더 깊은 이중 계층 앤사츠로 압축하고, 나머지 10개의 Trotter 단계 중 다섯 개는 일반 Trotter로 실행합니다
examples.suggested: …압축하고, 10개의 Trotter 단계 중 나머지 다섯 개는 일반 Trotter로 실행합니다
examples.why: 나머지 modifies '10개의 Trotter 단계' instead of the five, so it reads as 'the remaining 10 steps, five of which…' — implying more than 10 total. Same misplacement recurs at line 505 ('나머지 20단계 중 10단계').

examples.source: Queue wait is on top of both.
examples.translation: 큐 대기 시간은 이 두 시간에 추가됩니다.
examples.suggested: 큐 대기 시간은 이 두 가지 시간 모두에 더해집니다.
examples.why: 두 시간 in this position most naturally reads as 'two hours', and the sentence sits right after '거의 4시간'과 '약 18분', so the reader can take it as a third figure instead of 'both of those durations'.

examples.source: Basic exposure to tensor-network methods (DMRG and MPS) is helpful but not required
examples.translation: 텐서 네트워크 방법(DMRG 및 MPS)에 대한 기본적인 노출은 도움이 되지만 필수는 아니며
examples.suggested: 텐서 네트워크 기법(DMRG, MPS)을 접해본 경험이 있으면 도움이 되지만 필수는 아니며
examples.why: '기본적인 노출' is a word-for-word calque of 'basic exposure'; 노출 in Korean means physical/radiation exposure and no Korean technical writer would use it for prior acquaintance with a method.

examples.source: Serverless worker
examples.translation: Serverless 워커 (63, 87) vs 서버리스 워커 (361)
examples.suggested: Pick one form (Serverless 워커) and use it throughout
examples.why: The same component is named two ways within one file; harmless to comprehension but inconsistent, especially since 'Serverless' is kept capitalized in the title and headings.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no semantic drift or hallucination: the tricky quantitative passages all survive intact (interchain coupling "$J$의 약 ~2.7%", "논문의 $J$는 여기서 사용된 $J$의 두 배", the zero net magnetization caveat "별도의 뺄셈 없이", and the whole 50-qubit fidelity discussion including "이는 성능 저하가 아닙니다 … 이후 시간 단계는 더 많은 얽힘을 생성하여 압축하기가 더 어렵기 때문"). What a native editor would change is terminology consistency and a few calques: "time evolution" is 시간 진화 in the learning outcomes (line 24) but 시간 전개 everywhere after (lines 70, 74, 1138); "perturbation" is 교란 at line 24 but 섭동 thereafter; "Trotter" stays Latin in the outcomes (lines 24, 26) but is 트로터 in the body; ansatz layers are 1층/2층 in prose (lines 545, 553) but 레이어 in the comparison table (line 772). Line 80 renders "two-qubit gates" as "이-큐비트 게이트", where the Sino-Korean 이- momentarily reads as the demonstrative 이("this"); 2-큐비트 or 두 큐비트 is the field's convention. Line 52 renders "canonical Luttinger-liquid magnet" as "정준 러팅거 액체" — 정준 is the canonical-ensemble sense, not the "archetypal/textbook example" sense meant here (대표적인/전형적인). None of these would teach a false concept.

examples.source: How to prepare a ground state, apply a local perturbation, and perform Trotter time evolution on a quantum circuit.
examples.translation: 바닥 상태를 준비하고, 국소적 교란을 적용하며, 양자 회로에서 Trotter 시간 진화를 수행하는 방법.
examples.suggested: 바닥 상태를 준비하고, 국소 섭동을 가하며, 양자 회로에서 트로터 시간 전개를 수행하는 방법.
examples.why: The learning-outcomes list uses 교란 / 시간 진화 / Latin "Trotter", while the entire body of the file uses 섭동 / 시간 전개 / 트로터. Three terms split between the summary the learner reads first and the text that explains them.

examples.source: producing a "mixed" AQC + Trotter circuit with substantially fewer two-qubit gates.
examples.translation: 이-큐비트 게이트 수가 훨씬 적은 "혼합" AQC + 트로터 회로가 만들어집니다.
examples.suggested: 2-큐비트 게이트 수가 훨씬 적은 "혼합" AQC + 트로터 회로가 만들어집니다.
examples.why: "이-큐비트" (Sino-Korean 이 = two) is not the field's convention and collides with the demonstrative 이 ("this"), so it reads for a beat as "this qubit gate count". Korean Qiskit material writes 2-큐비트 / 두 큐비트.

examples.source: KCuF$_3$: a canonical Luttinger-liquid magnet
examples.translation: KCuF$_3$: 정준 러팅거 액체 자성체
examples.suggested: KCuF$_3$: 대표적인 러팅거 액체 자성체
examples.why: 정준 is the physics term for "canonical" in the canonical-ensemble/canonical-quantization sense; here "canonical" means archetypal/textbook. A Korean physicist reads 정준 러팅거 액체 as a named ensemble rather than "the standard example of".

examples.source: within each stage, each step warm-starts from the previous step's optimized parameters, and parameters are reset to the stage defaults at the stage boundary
examples.translation: 각 단계 내에서는 이전 단계의 최적화된 매개변수로 워밍스타트를 하며, 단계 경계에서는 매개변수가 해당 단계의 기본값으로 재설정됩니다.
examples.suggested: 각 스테이지 안에서는 직전 시간 단계의 최적화된 매개변수로 워밍스타트하고, 스테이지가 바뀌는 지점에서는 매개변수를 해당 스테이지의 기본값으로 재설정합니다.
examples.why: 단계 does double duty for both "stage" (one-layer vs two-layer phase) and "step" (Trotter time step), so "각 단계 내에서는 이전 단계의…" reads self-referentially and the within-stage restriction becomes unreadable. The net behavior still comes through from the following clause, so this is ambiguity rather than drift.

examples.source: the scattering intensity is concentrated near the antiferromagnetic wave vector $q = \pi$ at low energy
examples.translation: 산란 강도는 낮은 에너지의 반강자성 파수 $q = \pi$ 근처에 집중되어 있으며
examples.suggested: 산란 강도는 낮은 에너지에서 반강자성 파동 벡터(파수 벡터) $q = \pi$ 근처에 집중되어 있으며
examples.why: 파수 is "wavenumber" (a scalar); the source says wave vector, conventionally 파동 벡터 or 파수 벡터. Also "낮은 에너지의 … $q$" attaches the energy to the wave vector; the English attaches it to where the intensity sits (낮은 에너지에서).

examples.source: one single-qubit $Z$ embedded in the $n$-qubit identity string for each site
examples.translation: 각 사이트에 대해 $n$-큐비트 항등원 문자열에 임베딩된 단일 큐비트 $Z$입니다.
examples.suggested: 각 사이트마다 $n$-큐비트 항등 연산자 문자열에 하나의 단일 큐비트 $Z$를 끼워 넣은 형태입니다.
examples.why: 항등원 is the algebraic "identity element"; for a Pauli string the natural Korean is 항등 연산자 문자열. "임베딩된" is also an unnecessary transliteration where 끼워 넣은/삽입된 is the normal technical wording.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I found no semantic drift, inverted condition, swapped quantity or hallucinated claim; the numeric/pedagogical load (7 products under a 1-hour timeout, 2^20 = 1,048,576 assignments, 1002/879/1040 targets, "약 100회 반복이 필요한 변분 알고리즘과 달리 약 10회", the (0,)=5.0 / (0,1)=4.0 worked example, the preprocessing/transpilation/postprocessing level tables) all survives intact. What a native technical editor would fix is consistency: the same concept is rendered several ways within one file — "Region A/B" as 구역 A/B in the formulation section but 지역 A/B in the entire validation section; "bias-field" as 편향장 (§Iskay), 편향 필드 (§bf-DCQO, §Step 2/3) and 바이어스 필드 (§핵심 요점); "ground state" as 바닥 상태 in the algorithm section but 기저 상태 in the intro and conclusion; "solution" as 해 early (해 공간, 해 품질) and 솔루션 from §Step 4 on; "unconstrained" as 무제약 then 비제약; "products" as 제품 then 상품 (line 314). Two smaller slips: "coherence times of the hardware" is rendered 결어긋남 시간 (decoherence time) rather than 결맞음 시간, and the "## Step 4" heading was left in English while Steps 1–3 are 1단계/2단계/3단계. None of these would teach a learner anything false.

examples.source: assigns market $j$ to Region A … we calculate the actual sales in Region A
examples.translation: 시장 $j$를 구역 A에 할당 … 지역 A의 실제 판매량을 계산합니다
examples.suggested: Pick one — 구역 A/B throughout (it pairs with 영업 구역 in the intro)
examples.why: The same Region A/B is 구역 in the problem formulation and 지역 in the whole validation/quality section; a reader flipping between the two sections has to re-establish that they are the same object.

examples.source: bias-field
examples.translation: 편향장 / 편향 필드 / 바이어스 필드
examples.suggested: 편향 필드 everywhere (it is the dominant form in this file)
examples.why: Three renderings of the algorithm's headline concept inside one tutorial, including 바이어스 필드 in the 핵심 요점 summary where the learner is meant to recognize the term they just learned.

examples.source: Specially important for larger problems that cannot currently fit on the coherence times of the hardware.
examples.translation: 현재 하드웨어의 결어긋남 시간에 맞지 않는 더 큰 문제에 특히 중요합니다.
examples.suggested: 현재 하드웨어의 결맞음 시간 안에 들어가지 않는 더 큰 문제에 특히 중요합니다.
examples.why: 결어긋남 = decoherence; the English says coherence time (결맞음 시간). Recognizable and numerically near-equivalent, so not misleading, but it is the wrong half of the coherence/decoherence pair.

examples.source: the ground state (lowest energy state) … maintaining ground state fidelity
examples.translation: **바닥 상태**(최저 에너지 상태) … 기저 상태 충실도를 유지하면서
examples.suggested: 바닥 상태 in both places (it is the one glossed on first use)
examples.why: The conclusion switches to 기저 상태 for the term the body explicitly defined as 바닥 상태, weakening the callback the English conclusion makes.

examples.source: Control how much classical optimization, compensating for bit-flip errors with different number of greedy passes of a local search
examples.translation: 서로 다른 수의 지역 탐색 탐욕 패스를 통해 비트 플립 오류를 보정하는 고전적 최적화 양을 제어합니다
examples.suggested: 지역 탐색의 탐욕적 패스 횟수를 조절하여 비트 플립 오류를 얼마나 보정할지 결정합니다
examples.why: '서로 다른 수의 지역 탐색 탐욕 패스' is a four-noun calque of the English modifier stack; a Korean technical writer would turn 'different number of … passes' into 패스 횟수. Stiff, not wrong.

editor_note: No semantic drift or hallucination: every claim, quantity, condition and caveat in the prose matches the English (checked the gamma paragraph, the "postselection rate ≈ noisy fidelity" explanation, and the whole hardware section). The defect is a clean terminology break at the "## 대규모 하드웨어 예제" heading, where the file switches translation conventions mid-document: postselection 사후 선택 → 후선택, check 검사 → 체크, fidelity 충실도 → 피델리티, depolarizing 감극 → 디폴라이징, job 작업/잡, committed 반영 → 커밋 — so the same concepts are named differently in the simulator half and the hardware half. Two term choices are also imperfect: "coherent Pauli checks" is rendered 일관 파울리 검사 (reads as "consistent", losing the quantum-coherence sense; 결맞은/코히런트 파울리 검사 is the field's term), and "bare" is rendered 순수 (순수 노이즈 상태, 순수 회로), which collides with 순수 상태 = "pure state" used correctly earlier in the same file for 순수 안정자 상태. Nothing here would make a learner form a false belief; register (합니다체 declaratives + -세요 imperatives) is consistent throughout.

examples.source: Increase `hw_num_stabilizers` for a more precise fidelity estimate at the cost of more circuits per job
examples.translation: `hw_num_stabilizers`를 늘리면 잡당 회로 수가 늘어나는 대가로 더 정밀한 피델리티 추정치를 얻을 수 있으며
examples.suggested: … 더 정밀한 충실도 추정치를 …
examples.why: 'fidelity' is 충실도 everywhere in the first two-thirds (learning outcomes, background, steps 1-4) and abruptly becomes 피델리티 from the hardware section onward; the same concept carries two names in one page.

examples.source: the postselection rate is small and postselection discards most shots
examples.translation: 후선택 비율이 작아 후선택 과정에서 대부분의 샷이 버려집니다
examples.why: Earlier the file consistently uses 사후 선택 / 사후 선택률 (e.g. line 562 '검사를 더 추가할수록 사후 선택률이 낮아짐'); the hardware section switches to 후선택 / 후선택 비율.
examples.suggested: 사후 선택률이 작아 사후 선택 과정에서 …

examples.source: The samples that pass every check give a much better expectation value than the bare circuit
examples.translation: 모든 체크를 통과한 샘플은 순수 회로보다 훨씬 더 나은 기댓값을 제공하며
examples.suggested: 모든 검사를 통과한 샘플은 검사가 없는 회로보다 …
examples.why: Two slips in one clause: 'check' is 검사 throughout the first 70% but 체크 here; and 'bare' is rendered 순수, which in this document already means 'pure' (순수 안정자 상태 = pure stabilizer state, line 57), so 순수 회로 / 순수 노이즈 상태 reads against the established sense.

examples.source: builds on coherent Pauli checks (CPC) from Single-shot error mitigation by coherent Pauli checks
examples.translation: van den Berg 등이 작성한 [일관 파울리 검사를 통한 단발성 오류 완화]의 일관 파울리 검사(CPC)를 기반으로 합니다
examples.suggested: 결맞은(코히런트) 파울리 검사(CPC)
examples.why: 'Coherent' here is quantum coherence (the checks are applied coherently via ancilla entanglement); 일관 renders the everyday 'consistent' sense. The '(CPC)' tag and the linked English title keep it recognizable, so this is a term slip rather than a false concept.

examples.source: instead of inferring a uniform depolarizing channel from calibration data
examples.translation: 캘리브레이션 데이터로부터 균일한 디폴라이징 채널을 추론하는 대신
examples.suggested: 균일 감극 채널
examples.why: The simulator section uses the correct Korean term 감극 채널 twice ('균일 감극 채널을 추론합니다', '동일한 감극 모델'); the hardware section falls back to the transliteration 디폴라이징 for the same channel.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — I checked every quantitative and conditional claim (ε∈[0,0.5] clipping and "ε=0.5에서 WS-QAOA는 정확히 표준 QAOA로 환원됩니다", the ~49% p=1 triangle-graph bound settling near −0.74, "최적값 −1.50보다 훨씬 높은 약 −0.62", cut value 4 of 5 edges, and the closing convergence-plot vs. sampled-bitstring contrast in the last 40%) and found no drift, no dropped caveat, and no hallucinated sentence. Core terminology is correct and internally consistent (mixer→믹서, ansatz→앤사츠, ground state→바닥 상태, relaxation→완화, cost unitary→비용 유니터리, Ising Hamiltonian→이징 해밀토니안). What a native technical editor would still change is a handful of calques: "The underlying `OptimizationProblem`" became "하위 `OptimizationProblem`" (하위 = "sub-/subordinate", not "underlying"); "running example" became "실행 예제" (reads as "example we execute" rather than "예제로 계속 사용할"); "informed starting point" became "정보가 있는 시작점"; and "poor local minima / increased optimization cost" became "나쁜 지역 최솟값 … 증가된 최적화 비용" where Korean convention is 국소 최솟값 and a nominal "최적화 비용 증가". Register holds (합니다체 declaratives with 하세요 imperatives, no 드리/honorific slips).

examples.source: The underlying `OptimizationProblem` returned by `to_optimization_problem()` supports binary, integer, continuous, and spin variables
examples.translation: `to_optimization_problem()`이 반환하는 하위 `OptimizationProblem`은 이진, 정수, 연속, 스핀 변수를 지원하며
examples.suggested: `to_optimization_problem()`이 반환하는 기반 `OptimizationProblem`은 …
examples.why: 하위 means "sub-/child/lower-level" and implies a containment relation the English does not state; "underlying" here means the base object itself. Not misleading enough to teach a false concept, but wrong word.

examples.source: We use a small **max-cut** problem on a weighted graph as our running example.
examples.translation: 실행 예제로 가중 그래프에 대한 소규모 **max-cut** 문제를 사용합니다.
examples.suggested: 이 튜토리얼 전반에서 사용할 예제로 가중 그래프의 소규모 max-cut 문제를 다룹니다.
examples.why: "running example" is a rhetorical term (the example carried through the whole text); 실행 예제 calques it into "example that is executed", which a Korean technical writer would not use.

examples.source: WS-QAOA's informed starting point means COBYLA begins with a meaningful energy value
examples.translation: WS-QAOA의 정보가 있는 시작점은 COBYLA가 … 의미 있는 에너지 값으로 시작함을 의미하는 반면
examples.suggested: WS-QAOA는 사전 정보가 반영된 시작점을 쓰기 때문에 COBYLA가 …
examples.why: "정보가 있는 시작점" is a literal rendering of "informed"; the noun-subject + "…을 의미합니다" frame is calqued English syntax that reads as MT rather than native technical prose.

examples.source: random initialization can lead to slow convergence, poor local minima, and increased optimization cost
examples.translation: 무작위 초기화가 느린 수렴, 나쁜 지역 최솟값, 그리고 증가된 최적화 비용으로 이어질 수 있습니다
examples.suggested: 무작위 초기화 때문에 수렴이 느려지고, 좋지 않은 국소 최솟값에 갇히며, 최적화 비용이 커질 수 있습니다
examples.why: 국소 최솟값 is the established Korean term for "local minimum" (지역 최솟값 is unidiomatic here), and "증가된 … 비용" is an English past-participle calque; Korean prefers a verbal predicate.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful paragraph-by-paragraph, including the tricky Background contrast (classical cut point is deterministically 0/1 vs. "양자 회로에서는 절단 지점에서 Qubit의 상태가 일반적으로 혼합 상태입니다") and the +1 ideal-expectation setup with the "$\vec{\phi}$의 값에 무관하게" qualifier intact; core terms are correct and consistent (expectation value→기댓값, observable→관측량/서브관측량, eigenstate→고유 상태, basis→기저, transpile→트랜스파일, backend→백엔드, MBL→다체 국소화, hardware-efficient→하드웨어 효율적인). No dropped caveats, no swapped quantities, and the closing 40% (Move-gate expansion, +1 qubit, upstream measure / downstream eigenstate-prepare, uncut-vs-cut comparison) matches the English exactly.

Delta-only read of the 6 rewritten entries: the headings are idiomatic and conventional (Post-process→후처리, Further challenge→추가 도전 과제, Additional Info→추가 정보), the byline pair renders correctly as 작성자/검토자 with the source's spacing intact, and the license sentence ("이를 수정하거나 파생한 작업물은 이 저작권 고지를 유지해야 하며, 수정된 파일에는 원본에서 변경되었음을 나타내는 고지를 포함해야 합니다.") preserves both obligations — retain the copyright notice, and mark altered files as changed from the originals — with no softening, dropped clause, or added claim.

The CNOT paragraph opening section 4 has lost its first two sentences: the English "We start with the canonical two qubit gate, the controlled-NOT (also CNOT or CX) gate. Here, as with all controlled two qubit gates, one qubit is labelled as the 'control', while the other is called the 'target'." is simply absent, and the Korean paragraph begins mid-argument at "제어 Qubit가 $|0\rangle$ 상태에 있으면…". The CNOT/CX gate is therefore never introduced in the prose of this section, and 제어 Qubit / 대상 Qubit are used throughout the rest of section 4 without ever being defined — in a beginner hands-on this is a real pedagogical loss, and the sibling file i18n/ko/po/workshop/03_Qiskit 101 Hands-on.po translates the same msgid in full, confirming it is an omission and not a source quirk. Beyond that the file is faithful and reads well; the remaining issues are minor: core terms alternate between Korean and English forms within the same section (큐비트 조작하기 heading vs. Qubit은… body; 두 게이트 모두 vs. $X$ Gate; 회로를 실행하고 vs. 양자 Circuit), and one sentence is a literal calque ("'0'으로 끝날 확률" for "the probability to end in state '0'").

examples.source: We start with the canonical two qubit gate, the controlled-NOT (also CNOT or CX) gate.  Here, as with all controlled two qubit gates, one qubit is labelled as the "control", while the other is called the "target". If the control qubit is in state $|0\rangle$, it applies the identity $I$ gate to the target, …
examples.translation: 제어 Qubit가 $|0\rangle$ 상태에 있으면, 대상 Qubit에 항등 $I$ Gate를 적용하며, 즉 아무 연산도 수행되지 않습니다. …
examples.suggested: 두 Qubit의 대표적인 Gate인 controlled-NOT(CNOT 또는 CX) Gate부터 시작합니다. 모든 controlled 2-qubit Gate와 마찬가지로, 하나의 Qubit은 "제어(control)", 다른 하나는 "대상(target)"이라고 부릅니다. 제어 Qubit이 $|0\rangle$ 상태이면 …
examples.why: The two opening sentences are dropped: the CNOT/CX gate is never introduced, and the control/target labels the whole rest of section 4 depends on are never defined. The learner meets 제어 Qubit / 대상 Qubit cold, mid-paragraph. The identical msgid IS fully translated in the non-solution sibling PO, so this is an omission.

examples.source: Manipulating qubits / Qubits are manipulated by applying quantum gates. … Notice that both gates changed the value of $p$ … / Run your circuit …
examples.translation: ### 큐비트 조작하기 … Qubit은 양자 Gate를 적용하여 조작합니다. … 두 게이트 모두 $p$ 값을 바꾸었지만 … / ## 5. 회로를 실행하고 … 양자 Circuit을 구성하는 방법
examples.suggested: Pick one form per term and hold it: Qubit (or 큐비트), Gate (or 게이트), Circuit (or 회로) — headings included.
examples.why: Within-file inconsistency: qubit appears as 큐비트/Qubit/qubit, gate as Gate/게이트, circuit as 회로/Circuit — sometimes two forms in adjacent sentences (L328: "제어 Qubit와 대상 qubit"). Recognizable, so MINOR, but a native editor would normalize it.

examples.source: e.g., $|a|^2$ would be the probability to end in state '0' on both qubits.
examples.translation: 예를 들어, $|a|^2$는 두 qubit 모두 '0'으로 끝날 확률입니다.
examples.suggested: 예를 들어, $|a|^2$는 두 Qubit이 모두 '0'으로 측정될 확률입니다.
examples.why: "'0'으로 끝날 확률" is a literal calque of "end in state 0"; in Korean measurement-outcome prose a native writer says 측정될 확률 / '0'이 나올 확률. Meaning survives, so MINOR.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — the CX conditional ("첫 번째 Qubit이 $|1\rangle$일 때만"), the ZZI/III expectation-value explanation, the 2-qubit-depth `n`→`n/2` claim, the resilience-level trade-off, and the whole teleportation section all carry the English exactly, with no hallucinated or inverted content. The defects are editorial. The worst is line 852, where the English appositive "Variational Quantum Algorithms, a class of hybrid quantum-classical algorithms…" got re-attached to the wrong subject: "이 Ansatz는 … 핵심 구성 요소로, … 하이브리드 양자-고전 알고리즘의 한 분류입니다" predicates "is a class of hybrid quantum-classical algorithms" of the *ansatz*, not of VQA (recoverable only because the preceding sentence correctly defines Ansatz as 시험 양자 상태). Line 571 contains the ungrammatical nominalization "거리가 멀어질수록의 동작", and lines 704/710 split one English sentence into a redundant pair ("인코딩하고 싶다고 가정해 보세요." … "…인코딩하는 것이 목표입니다. 목표는 … 준비하는 것입니다") with a dangling "를" after the display math and 목표 repeated twice. Terminology: "basis gates" is rendered "기본 Gate" (line 371) rather than 기저 Gate; "observable" is 관측량 eight times but 관측값 once in the conclusion (line 867); "job" appears as 작업 / Job / job; and "a family of functions/states" is flattened to 함수 집합 / 상태의 집합 rather than 함수족. Register (합니다체 + ~하세요, no 드립니다/십시오) is consistent.

examples.source: These Ansatzes are a central component of Variational Quantum Algorithms, a class of hybrid quantum-classical algorithms that use a quantum computer to evaluate a cost function and a classical optimizer to minimize it.
examples.translation: 이 Ansatz는 [변분 양자 알고리즘(Variational Quantum Algorithms)]의 핵심 구성 요소로, 양자 컴퓨터를 사용하여 비용 함수를 평가하고 고전 최적화기를 사용하여 이를 최소화하는 하이브리드 양자-고전 알고리즘의 한 분류입니다.
examples.suggested: 이 Ansatz는 [변분 양자 알고리즘(Variational Quantum Algorithms)]의 핵심 구성 요소입니다. 변분 양자 알고리즘은 양자 컴퓨터로 비용 함수를 평가하고 고전 최적화기로 이를 최소화하는 하이브리드 양자-고전 알고리즘의 한 부류입니다.
examples.why: The English appositive describes Variational Quantum Algorithms; in Korean the final predicate 입니다 binds to 이 Ansatz는, so the sentence literally says the ansatz IS a class of hybrid quantum-classical algorithms — contradicting the correct definition (시험 양자 상태) given one sentence earlier.

examples.source: This example uses the `ZZ` operators between qubits to examine the behavior as they get farther apart.
examples.translation: 이 예제에서는 qubit 간 거리가 멀어질수록의 동작을 살펴보기 위해 qubit 사이의 `ZZ` 연산자를 사용합니다.
examples.suggested: 이 예제에서는 qubit 사이의 거리가 멀어질 때 동작이 어떻게 변하는지 살펴보기 위해 qubit 간 `ZZ` 연산자를 사용합니다.
examples.why: ‘~ㄹ수록의’ is not a valid Korean nominal construction; ‘멀어질수록의 동작’ is ungrammatical and reads as raw MT in an otherwise clean paragraph.

examples.source: Let's consider a simple example. Suppose we want to encode the classical vector $$\vec{x}$$ into a quantum state of two qubits. The goal is to prepare the quantum state:
examples.translation: 간단한 예시를 살펴보겠습니다. 고전 벡터를 인코딩하고 싶다고 가정해 보세요. … 를 두 개의 qubit 양자 상태로 인코딩하는 것이 목표입니다. 목표는 다음 양자 상태를 준비하는 것입니다:
examples.suggested: 간단한 예시를 살펴보겠습니다. 다음 고전 벡터를 … 두 개의 qubit 양자 상태로 인코딩한다고 가정해 보겠습니다. 목표는 다음 양자 상태를 준비하는 것입니다:
examples.why: The English sentence that wraps the display equation was split into two, so ‘인코딩’ is stated twice, the fragment after the math starts with a dangling object particle ‘를’, and ‘목표입니다. 목표는’ repeats 목표 in consecutive clauses.

examples.source: …must consider the device's basis gates and qubit connectivity.
examples.translation: 장치의 기본 Gate와 qubit 연결성을 고려해야 합니다.
examples.suggested: 장치의 기저 Gate(basis gate)와 qubit 연결성을 고려해야 합니다.
examples.why: ‘basis gates’ is the hardware's native gate set; 기본 renders it as ‘basic/default’, whereas the established Korean domain term is 기저 게이트. Recognizable but imprecise.

examples.source: …from building quantum gates to defining and measuring observables…
examples.translation: 양자 Gate 구성부터 관측값 정의 및 측정에 이르기까지…
examples.suggested: 양자 Gate 구성부터 관측량 정의 및 측정에 이르기까지…
examples.why: The file uses 관측량 for ‘observable’ eight times (sections 2.1–2.5); the conclusion switches to 관측값, which in Korean means the measured value rather than the operator being measured.

editor_note: The rewritten opening sentence is semantically faithful and reads naturally: "walk through a Qiskit Patterns workflow, and use Qiskit's Sampler primitive" → "Qiskit Patterns 워크플로를 따라가며, Qiskit의 Sampler 프리미티브를 사용합니다" — no drift, no dropped qualifier, correct 합니다체, and 프리미티브 is used consistently (6/6) across the file. The one editorial defect is that this rewrite spells "workflow" as 워크플로, while the rest of the page spells the same term 워크플로우 (frontmatter description, and the Post-process step at line 383: "이 결과를 다른 워크플로우에 전달하거나"). Both spellings are defensible in isolation, so nothing misleads a learner, but a native technical editor would harmonize the two — preferably to 워크플로우, since that is the majority form already in the file.

examples.source: In this notebook you will walk through a Qiskit Patterns workflow, and use Qiskit's [Sampler primitive](...).
examples.translation: 이 노트북에서는 Qiskit Patterns 워크플로를 따라가며, Qiskit의 [Sampler 프리미티브](...)를 사용합니다.
examples.suggested: 이 노트북에서는 Qiskit Patterns 워크플로우를 따라가며, Qiskit의 [Sampler 프리미티브](...)를 사용합니다.
examples.why: Meaning and register are correct; only the transliteration of "workflow" diverges from the rest of the page, which uses 워크플로우 (line 383 body text and the frontmatter description). Same term, two spellings within one file — MINOR consistency slip, not misleading.

editor_note: No misleading drift: all five criteria, the GHZ ideal-vs-noisy narrative, the T₁ delay experiment, the CCX→rz/sx/ecr decomposition and the 2% readout-error setup are all rendered faithfully, and the EN's own criterion-number quirk in the intro ("측정하는 방법(기준 4) … 범용 Gate를 구성하는 방식(기준 3)") is reproduced rather than "fixed". The defects are editorial. (1) The criteria-6/7 paragraph (line ~521) breaks the whole file's conventions at once: "큐비트" instead of the Qubit used in the other ~60 occurrences, "'나는(flying)' 큐비트" instead of the established "비행 Qubit", and the calque "그녀의 얽힌 쌍 절반" — Korean technical prose would write "Alice의 얽힌 쌍 절반"; this one paragraph reads as untouched MT next to the rest. (2) "two of the most critical goals" is flattened to "가장 중요한 목표 중 하나" (line ~379), dropping the count. (3) "fidelity" is 충실도 throughout section 1 but becomes "정확도" in the conclusion bullet (line ~535). (4) The hedge in "would likely see similar, non-zero counts" is asserted flatly as "나타날 것입니다" (line ~503).

examples.source: In a real quantum network, the shared entangled pair would be created by distributing "flying" qubits (like photons) between Alice and Bob's locations … map Alice's stationary qubit state onto her half of the entangled pair
examples.translation: 실제 양자 네트워크에서는 공유된 얽힌 쌍이 Alice와 Bob의 위치 사이에 '나는(flying)' 큐비트(예: 광자)를 분배함으로써 생성됩니다 … Alice의 정지된 큐비트 상태를 그녀의 얽힌 쌍 절반에 매핑하여
examples.suggested: 실제 양자 네트워크에서는 Alice와 Bob의 위치 사이에 '비행(flying)' Qubit(예: 광자)을 분배하여 공유 얽힌 쌍을 생성합니다 … Alice의 정지 Qubit 상태를 Alice가 가진 얽힌 쌍의 절반에 매핑하여
examples.why: This single paragraph abandons the file's own conventions — 큐비트 vs. Qubit everywhere else, '나는' vs. the '비행 Qubit' used in the intro, section heading and conclusion — and '그녀의' is an English-possessive calque a Korean technical writer would not use. It reads as raw MT dropped into an otherwise well-edited page.

examples.source: This is why improving coherence times and making gates faster are two of the most critical goals in quantum hardware research.
examples.translation: 바로 이 때문에 결맞음 시간을 개선하고 Gate를 더 빠르게 만드는 것이 양자 하드웨어 연구에서 가장 중요한 목표 중 하나입니다.
examples.suggested: 바로 이 때문에 결맞음 시간 개선과 Gate 속도 향상은 양자 하드웨어 연구에서 가장 중요한 두 가지 목표입니다.
examples.why: The English names two distinct goals; the Korean collapses them into a single '중요한 목표 중 하나'. Not misleading about the physics, but a dropped quantity in a summary sentence learners are meant to carry away.

examples.source: seeing the effect of finite T₁, T₂ on algorithm fidelity
examples.translation: 유한한 T₁, T₂가 알고리즘 정확도에 미치는 영향
examples.suggested: 유한한 T₁, T₂가 알고리즘 충실도에 미치는 영향
examples.why: 'fidelity' is consistently 충실도 in section 1 ('출력 충실도', '높은 충실도를 유지'), but the conclusion switches to 정확도 (accuracy), which is a different quantity in this domain.

examples.source: you could run the same circuit and would likely see similar, non-zero counts for the incorrect outcomes
examples.translation: 동일한 Circuit을 실행하면, 틀린 결과에 대해서도 유사하게 0이 아닌 카운트가 나타날 것입니다
examples.suggested: 동일한 Circuit을 실행하면, 틀린 결과에 대해서도 유사하게 0이 아닌 카운트가 나타날 가능성이 높습니다
examples.why: 'would likely' is a hedge about real-hardware behavior; the Korean states it as a plain expectation. Small, but the surrounding device-example paragraphs elsewhere keep their hedges.

editor_note: Meaning is faithful throughout — no inverted conditions, no swapped quantities, no hallucinated claims; the deliberately odd EN criterion-number mapping in the intro (측정…기준 4 / 보편 Gate…기준 3 / 결맞음…기준 5) is preserved rather than "corrected", and the noisy-vs-ideal, T1-decay and CCX-decomposition explanations teach as well as the English. The defects are consistency and word-choice: "Exercise" is rendered 실습 for 1a/1b/2 but 연습 for 3/4/5, and the in-text cross-reference at the end of Criterion 5 points at "연습 1b: 실제 IBM 양자 컴퓨터에서 실행하기" while the actual heading reads "실습 1b: 실제 IBM Quantum 컴퓨터에서 실행하기"; "ground state" is rendered 기저 상태 (Korean physics uses 바닥 상태) in the same file where 기저 already carries "basis" (계산 기저, 기저 Gate); the final criteria-6/7 paragraph abandons the file's own conventions, switching to 큐비트, 나는(flying) 큐비트, 정지된 큐비트 and 순간이동 after 100+ lines of Qubit, 비행 Qubit, 고정 Qubit and 양자 텔레포테이션, and adds the calque 그녀의 얽힌 쌍 절반. Also 유니타리 (intro) vs 유니터리 (Criterion 4), and "long relevant decoherence times" flattened to 적절한 (appropriate) 결어긋남 시간 with "or any IBM device" losing its "any".

examples.source: Running on a real device was demonstrated in **Exercise 1b: Run on real IBM Quantum computer**.
examples.translation: 실제 장치에서의 실행은 **연습 1b: 실제 IBM 양자 컴퓨터에서 실행하기**에서 시연되었습니다.
examples.suggested: 실제 장치에서의 실행은 **실습 1b: 실제 IBM Quantum 컴퓨터에서 실행하기**에서 시연되었습니다.
examples.why: The file titles the exercises 실습 1a/1b/2 but 연습 3/4/5, and this cross-reference cites a heading text (연습 1b, IBM 양자) that does not exist in the document (실습 1b, IBM Quantum). Pick one rendering of "Exercise" and make the pointer match the heading verbatim.

examples.source: a known reference state (typically the ground state |0〉 for each qubit) … cools the qubit down to ground state
examples.translation: 알려진 기준 상태(일반적으로 각 Qubit의 기저 상태 |0〉) … Qubit을 기저 상태로 냉각시킵니다
examples.suggested: 알려진 기준 상태(일반적으로 각 Qubit의 바닥 상태 |0〉) … Qubit을 바닥 상태로 냉각시킵니다
examples.why: 기저 상태 reads as "basis state", and this same file uses 기저 for "basis" elsewhere (계산 기저, 기저 Gate), so a learner can misread the initialization target as a basis state rather than the energy ground state. 바닥 상태 is the standard Korean physics term.

examples.source: the shared entangled pair would be created by distributing "flying" qubits (like photons) … map Alice's stationary qubit state onto her half of the entangled pair
examples.translation: 공유된 얽힌 쌍이 … '나는(flying)' 큐비트(예: 광자)를 분배함으로써 생성됩니다 … Alice의 정지된 큐비트 상태를 그녀의 얽힌 쌍 절반에 매핑하여
examples.suggested: … '비행' Qubit(예: 광자)을 분배함으로써 생성됩니다 … Alice의 고정 Qubit 상태를 Alice가 보유한 얽힘 쌍의 절반에 매핑하여
examples.why: This last paragraph drops every convention the rest of the file established (Qubit→큐비트, 비행→나는, 고정→정지된, 양자 텔레포테이션→순간이동), and 그녀의 얽힌 쌍 절반 is an English-possessive calque no Korean technical writer would use.

examples.source: arbitrary unitary operations … any multi-qubit unitary can be composed from 1- and 2-qubit gates
examples.translation: 임의의 유니타리 연산 … 임의의 다중 qubit 유니터리는 1- 및 2-Qubit Gate로 구성될 수 있습니다
examples.suggested: Use one spelling throughout — 유니터리 (or 유니타리) in both places
examples.why: The same term is transliterated two different ways within one file; harmless to comprehension but a native editor would unify it.

examples.source: "Long relevant decoherence times, much longer than the gate operation time." … On hardware like ibmq_brisbane (127 qubits) or any IBM device
examples.translation: "Gate 동작 시간보다 훨씬 긴 적절한 결어긋남 시간." … **ibmq_brisbane**(127 qubit) 또는 IBM 장치에서는
examples.suggested: "Gate 동작 시간보다 훨씬 긴, 관련된 결어긋남 시간." … ibmq_brisbane(127 qubit)이나 그 밖의 어떤 IBM 장치에서든
examples.why: 적절한 means "appropriate", not DiVincenzo's "relevant" (i.e. the decoherence channels that matter for the computation); and the universal quantifier "any" is dropped, weakening the claim that this holds for every IBM device. Neither misleads outright, but both shade the meaning.
